summary: Expensify is a cloud-based expense management SaaS with low switching costs. Its main supply-chain dependencies are cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure) and payment networks (Visa/Mastercard). The recent tender offer reduced headcount, while its new AI MCP feature may boost growth, but churn and competition remain key risks.

inputs.whyNeeded: Hosting and compute for SaaS platform
inputs.concentration: High; dominated by AWS, Azure, GCP
inputs.fragility: Moderate; cost increases can squeeze margins, but service is typically reliable

inputs.whyNeeded: Processing of corporate credit card transactions and expense flows
inputs.concentration: High; duopoly of Visa and Mastercard
inputs.fragility: Moderate; terms or fee changes could impact revenue

inputs.whyNeeded: Third-party libraries and APIs for functionality

chokepoints.why: Single provider lock-in could lead to pricing power; outage would halt service
No easy replacement; network access essential for card features

customers.why: Primary end users of expense management, diverse and global (low concentration)

geographic: US-based headquarters, global customer base with no single region dominating

bearCase: Low switching costs lead to high churn; tender offer may signal desperation; AI MCP feature may not differentiate; competition from Concur/Bill.com; cloud cost inflation pressures margins

loadBearing.breaksIf: Major cloud provider raises prices by >10% or introduces new fees

loadBearing.assumption: Payment network access continues on current terms
loadBearing.breaksIf: Visa/Mastercard change fee structures or terminate agreement

loadBearing.assumption: Customer retention stabilizes after tender offer
loadBearing.breaksIf: Churn increases due to product dissatisfaction or competitive pressure

loadBearing.assumption: AI MCP feature drives new sales or upsells
loadBearing.breaksIf: Feature fails to gain traction, adoption is low, or competitors replicate quickly

prediction.statement: Q2 2026 earnings report in August 2026 should show revenue stabilization or modest growth driven by AI MCP, but churn may still weigh
prediction.resolutionCriterion: Revenue year-over-year growth rate vs consensus; if positive and >0%, likely bullish

gaps: No data on customer churn rate post-tender

verifyThese: Check Expensify's SEC filings for cloud provider concentration and payment network agreements
Monitor blog/press for AI MCP usage statistics

diminishingReturns: Deep dependency chain ends at cloud and payments; further hops (e.g., chip supply for cloud) have minimal impact on Expensify within 1-2 years, so chain is not extended.
